how.title: From elevation to heirloom
how.steps.0.title: You choose the place
how.steps.0.body: Anywhere with real relief. We pull topographic elevation for the exact patch you frame on the map.
how.steps.1.title: We mill the mountains
how.steps.1.body: The heightfield is wrapped into a band and CNC-cut in wax, preserving every ridge and valley at wearable scale.
how.steps.2.title: Cast in precious metal
how.steps.2.body: Lost-wax cast in recycled gold, silver or platinum, then hand-finished. A summit you can hold.
collections.title: Choose your form
collections.sub: Every piece starts from the same idea — a real place — and takes the shape that suits it.

materials.title: Choose your metal
materials.sub: Every piece is cast in recycled precious metal, then hand-finished. Your exact price updates live as you design — no surprises.

materials.metals.2.blurb: The densest, most durable finish we cast. Understated and permanent.

faq.title: Questions, answered
faq.items.0.a: Choose any meaningful place on the map, and we'll transform its real topography into a handcrafted piece of jewelry made from recycled 925 sterling silver.
faq.items.1.a: Each piece is made to order within approximately 1–2 weeks and carefully shipped to you.
faq.items.2.q: Can I choose any place in the world?
faq.items.2.a: Yes. You can select almost any location with real terrain—from mountains and coastlines to lakes and city streets.
faq.items.3.a: Every Mémoire piece is handcrafted from recycled 925 sterling silver.
faq.items.4.a: If there's an issue with your order, we'll work with you to make it right. Please contact us within 30 days of delivery.
final.title: Your place, made to keep.
final.sub: Designing is free and takes about a minute. You only pay when you order.
priceList.title: Simple, honest pricing
priceList.sub: Every piece is cast in recycled 925 silver and made to order. One price per form — the exact figure is confirmed as you design.
